scenes.title: Room 520 Covered Mineral-Optics Workstation
scenes.institution: University of Chicago Laboratory for Mineral Physics — room 520 optical bay
scenes.reference_notes: Official numbered room-tour photograph 69, optical-table header and room plan inspected. The plan registers point 69 inside research room 520. Photo shows a large covered optical table on cylindrical isolators, laser curtains and adjacent equipment racks; header reveals lens mounts and translation stages but is not spatially registered to the covered table. Two room photos out of 25 numbered views were reviewed; not a complete tour. Header optics cannot be assumed to belong at exact locations beneath the cover. Plan gives room 520 area of 1006 square feet, but no surveyed edge lengths; apparatus dimensions and optical response unverified.
observed_cues: Large stainless removable optical-table enclosure with individual top-panel handles.
Heavy cylindrical isolation legs and floor-standing instrument racks flank the optical table.
Black movable laser curtains subdivide a mapped research room rather than permanent identical small rooms.
